label: Resonator (resonator-smd)
description: Resonator Small SMD resonator. This is the itty bitty 10/20MHz resonators with built in caps. CSTCE10M0G55 and CSTCE20M0V53. Footprint has been reviewed closely but hasn't been tested yet.
